caption: The drawing depicts a wooden rocking chair with a high back that consists of three horizontal slats and two vertical posts ending in rounded finials at the top. The wood is a light brown color, and the construction is made up of rounded poles and spindle supports. The seat appears to be woven and is grayish in color, contrasting with the wooden frame. The chair is shown at an angle, revealing both the full side and part of the front of the chair, making the curved rockers at the bottom clearly visible. The background is plain and off-white, with no other objects or details present.
title: Shaker Child's Rocker
